mainEntity.name: How do I find a registered BAS agent near me?

acceptedAnswer.text: Enter your postcode and needs in our 60-second questionnaire. We match you with a TPB-registered BAS Agent whose services fit your situation. You can verify any agent on the public TPB register at tpb.gov.au. The matching is free with no obligation.

mainEntity.name: What's the difference between a BAS agent and a bookkeeper?

acceptedAnswer.text: A bookkeeper records your day-to-day transactions. A registered BAS Agent has the legal authorisation under the Tax Agent Services Act 2009 to prepare and lodge your BAS for a fee. Many bookkeepers are also registered BAS Agents — we match you to someone who can do both where that suits your business.

mainEntity.name: Can a BAS agent near me lodge overdue BAS?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Our network includes BAS Agents experienced in catch-up work — preparing and lodging multiple overdue periods, reconciling GST for prior quarters, and requesting penalty remission where mitigating circumstances exist. Tell us you are behind in the questionnaire.

mainEntity.name: Is BAS agent matching really free?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. The matching service is free for businesses. We are engaged by the accounting firms in our network, not by you. You are under no obligation to proceed with any matched firm, and the matched agent gives you a clear quote for any work before you commit.

mainEntity.name: How much does a BAS agent cost?

acceptedAnswer.text: BAS preparation alone is usually $250–$400 per quarter depending on transaction volume. The matched BAS Agent gives you a clear quote after reviewing your needs — the matching is free.

mainEntity.name: Can a BAS agent set up my GST and PAYG reporting correctly?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. The matched BAS Agent reviews your GST coding, confirms your PAYG withholding and instalment cycles, and ensures your activity statements are prepared accurately from the start — so you avoid amending prior periods later.

mainEntity.name: How quickly will a matched BAS agent contact me?

acceptedAnswer.text: Most matches are completed within 60 seconds of finishing the questionnaire. Your matched BAS Agent will typically reach out within 2 hours, or you can call for immediate assistance to discuss your needs.

mainEntity.name: Can a BAS agent work in the software I already use?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. We match you with a BAS Agent fluent in your existing platform — Xero, QuickBooks Online, MYOB or Reckon. There is no forced migration; the matched agent logs in, reviews your coding, and lodges directly from the software you already run.
